title: Codka Ka Yimid Yaabka
intro: Sheeko ku saabsan dulqaadka iyo naxariista aan xadka lahayn ee Rabbaaniga ah ayaa ku soo ifbaxaysa Qur'aanka. Rasuul ayaa loo diray magaalo weyn, laakiin dadkoodu way diideen digniinta oo way diideen runta. Niyad jab awgeed, naftani way baxday - oo waxaa lagu tijaabiyay badda kacsan oo lagu liqay mugdiga ugu mugdiga badan. Caloosha mugdiga, codsi hoos u dhac ah ayaa ka soo baxay, Raxmaankuna wuu ka jawaabay. Waa kuma naftan soo baxday oo isbeddeshay, dadkiisuna waxay noqon doonaan kuwo rumaysta in ka badan boqol kun?
clues: Waxaa la ii diray digniin magaalo weyn oo dadkii degganaa ay ka leexdeen waddada iimaanka.
Dadkayga si isdaba joog ah ayaan runta ugu yeeray, laakiin way ku jeesjeeseen oo way diideen fariintaydii.
Waan ka tagay iyaga anigoo niyad jabsan ka hor inta aan la ii ogolaan, oo waxaan u dhaqaaqay dhanka badda furan.
Duufaan weyn ayaa kacday, waxaana laygu tuuray badda - ka dibna waxaa liqay xayawaan weyn oo badda ku nool.

Lakabyo mugdi ah - qoto dheer oo badda ah, caloosha xayawaanka, iyo sagxadda badda ee qoto dheer - ayaan ku qayliyey: 'Ilaah kale ma jiro adiga mooyee; ammaantaadu ha ahaato; waxaan ka mid ahaa kuwa daalimiinta ah.'
Ilaahay baa iga badbaadiyey qotoda dheer, markii aan soo laabtayna, in ka badan boqol kun oo qof oo ka mid ah dadkaygii ayaa xaqa qaatay.

outcome.answer: Waxaa laga badbaadiyay gudcurka; dad badan baa rumaystay

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
